# T3raTech Solutions

> Zimbabwean software company (Harare) building the T3rnel agent stack:
> T3rnel Browser (97 MCP tools driving your real browser), WavePay (payments
> + licensing API), Market Pulse (evidence-graded agent-work lanes),
> Document Intelligence (MCP document extraction), Business Intelligence
> (offline-first ledger), plus the SciTech Zimbabwe community.

## Docs

- [Products](https://t3ratech.co.zw/): the product map
- [T3rnel Browser](https://t3ratech.co.zw/extensions): 97-tool MCP browser extension
- [MCP Session Bridge](https://t3ratech.co.zw/mcp): npx install, any MCP client
- [WavePay](https://t3ratech.co.zw/wavepay): payments/licensing, agent-registerable
- [Market Pulse](https://t3ratech.co.zw/market-pulse): graded agent work lanes
- [Document Intelligence](https://t3ratech.co.zw/document-intelligence): MCP document Q&A
- [Skills](https://t3ratech.co.zw/skills): SKILL.md packs for agents
- [AGENTS.md](https://t3ratech.co.zw/AGENTS.md): the agent contract
